title: Exploring the Potential of Explainable AI in Brain Tumor Detection and Classification: A Systematic Review
core_idea: This systematic review examines explainable AI (XAI) methods applied to brain tumor detection and classification, emphasizing model interpretability, transparency, and the role of explanations in building confidence, ensuring safety, and enabling clinical adoption rather than focusing solely on accuracy.
tldr: A systematic review of XAI approaches for brain tumor detection/classification that prioritizes interpretability, confidence, safety, and clinical adoption in healthcare AI.
